name: Brannik Froststep
source_profile: ● Brannik Froststep (CN) is a celebrated mountain guide who sells his services to merchants, explorers, and occasionally smugglers. He considers the clans' restrictions on outsiders unnecessarily severe.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 58 (source excerpt; may be partial)
